messages.subject: Urgent: Submit mid-term evaluations
messages.body_plain:
Hi GSOC mentors,

At the time of writing, 10/23 project mentors with mid-term evaluations due this week still haven't submitted them.  A reminder that the deadline is tomorrow (10th July) at 18:00 UTC.
If you are in the US time zones, then please try to submit your evaluations today as you don't want to get caught out tomorrow - and give us gray hair in the process!

I will chase individuals later today.  If evaluations are not submitted on-time then, along with delays to payment for contributors, there are consequences for the R-project's potential future participation in GSOC.  We really appreciate your on-time submissions.

Thanks,

Rebecca

Pronouns: They/Them/Theirs
Please note:  Whilst I may choose to correspond by email during evenings and weekends as it fits best with my preferred working pattern, I do not expect responses outside your usual working pattern.

 <https://outlook.office.com/bookwithme/user/f2d...@lancaster.ac.uk?anonymous&ep=bwmEmailSignature>
Book time to meet with me <https://outlook.office.com/bookwithme/user/f2d...@lancaster.ac.uk?anonymous&ep=bwmEmailSignature>
